verdict.rationale: Install takes one or two commands: `/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace` then `/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace` for Claude Code, or `devin plugins install obra/superpowers` for Devin CLI. Getting Started covers many harnesses, and skills auto-trigger with no further setup. A real end-to-end runtime probe installed a skill with a single `npx skills add` command, and the installed SKILL.md read back cleanly. missing for 10: no timed walkthrough confirming the under-five-minutes claim, a single unified quickstart (installation differs by harness), and a more conventional install path for Codex/OpenCode, where the agent fetches and follows a raw INSTALL.md.
